trigger: Set piece: the freight car on the siding above the trench.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The freight car sits on a siding above the trench. Brake on, coupler free. Drop it and the Bradley's stuck.

nodes.speaker: roz
nodes.text: [Over the radio] Pearce! Baby! Whatever you're doing up there, do it now! They're at the warehouse gates!

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: If the car drops, the trench is blocked for a year. The Floor keeps its warehouses. The Army gets angry.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Forty tons of grain hopper tip into the trench. The Bradley stops a car-length short. Downtown cheers.

nodes.speaker: roz
nodes.text: THAT'S MY MECHANIC! Baby, you eat free at the Spur for the rest of your life! However long that is!

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The Bradley grinds past below you. By morning the Floor's warehouses are empty. Roz stops answering.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Dawn. Rain. The city counts its dead and its stores, and neither number is honest.
